location_fine: living room of a modest flat
visual_synopsis: In a bare living room a chubby schoolboy in a black tracksuit sits over his homework in a red armchair and keeps turning to his parents: the mustachioed father who stays buried in his newspaper on the sofa, and the mother (a male actor in a curly red wig and lipstick) sprawled under a blanket with the TV remote. The three argue back and forth in close-up until the boy throws his hands up in exasperation.
